WELCOME RACE FANS!
On behalf of over 500 members of Eastern Wisconsin Stock Cars, we would like to
welcome you to Sheboygan County Fairgrounds. The quarter-mile Plymouth race
track is one of the best dirt tracks in Wisconsin.
We run three classes of competition: The open-wheeled Modified, the late-model-
appearing Sportsmen, and the fender-bending. Hobby Stocks.
We hope you enjoy our race program and will come back and visit us often. Please
support our program's advertisers as they made this book possible. Tell them you saw
their ad in our program.

You start worrying about the fice day forecast every

because it's the first Sunday of August.

The races on your driveway include 3 divisions: big
wheels, bikes and remote control cars.
